Target node requires authenticated access to RaspAP 2.5 web interface, but the target CVE description is not supplied and target mapping status is missing. The edge label's bridge from default pi credentials to RaspAP web credential extraction/modification relies on unverified conditions such as same-host RaspAP deployment, readable/modifiable credential storage, or credential reuse. With absent environment data, this edge cannot enter a strict graph as stated; it is unsupported/overbroad, though it could become conditional if those missing conditions were verified.
